tests.name: series_embedding
tests.sql: WITH r AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT rvbbit.clover_tspulse('timeseries_embed',jsonb_build_object('values',(SELECT jsonb_agg(sin(i/10.0)) FROM generate_series(1,512) i))::text) AS v) SELECT ((v->>'dimension')::int > 0 AND jsonb_array_length(v->'embedding')=(v->>'dimension')::int) FROM r
tests.description: Run a 512-point series through TSPulse and verify the embedding dimension.
